subject: Commit and Rollback
notes: kb/Work PB3338 (wave 1154) and PB3540 (wave 1157): the APPLY COMMIT clause, COMMIT and ROLLBACK are provided for RELATIVE and INDEXED files, whose keyed store engine keeps the transaction (kb/Work PB3337); a SEQUENTIAL or LINE SEQUENTIAL file named in the clause is under commit control too, its transaction journal being kb/Work PB3340 (COBOL1709, which refused it, is retired) (Annex A.4.3 stays PARTIAL, docs/CONFORMANCE.md 5; this rule's obligations are met for every file the clause admits). EC-FLOW-COMMIT and EC-FLOW-ROLLBACK are raised for a COMMIT or ROLLBACK with an active clause under an active SORT or MERGE or under the control of a recursive runtime element (8.6.6: a RECURSIVE program, a function, a method): the module stack marks the frame of each recursive and TransactionControl.FlowForbidden asks ModuleStack.AnyRecursive, so a program a method CALLs raises them.
